caption: A wet bar of soap is squeezed in a hand in the bath, slips out of the grip and skids across the bottom of the tub.

sa.check: A wet bar of soap is squeezed in a hand in a bath.
It slips out of the grip.
It skids across the bottom of the tub.
The squeeze comes first, then the slip, then the skid.

pc.expect: It leaves the hand as the fingers close and not before, then skids and slows or stops against the side.
pc.fail: It hovers; or changes direction on its own; or stays stuck to the hand.

pc.expect: It shoots out in one direction and skids in a straight line.
pc.fail: It curves; or reverses; or goes straight up.

pc.expect: It drops to the tub bottom and stays on it.
pc.fail: It floats; or rises; or hangs.

pc.expect: The slippery soap slides on the wet surface.
pc.fail: It sticks dead on landing; or bounces like rubber; or dissolves instantly.

pc.expect: One bar of soap keeps its number.
pc.fail: It duplicates; or vanishes; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The soap and the tub stay the same.
pc.fail: The soap changes colour; or the tub changes; or the bathroom rearranges.

note: The hand is kept as the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
